Several '''internal conflicts''' occurred on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Exocron]] during the [[Devisors]]' rule. Several factions challenged the ruling caste's right to rule, forcing the Devisors and the [[Ruling council (Exocron)|ruling council]] to use the [[Exocron Airfleet]] against the rebellious elements of their society.
